label: Diwali
description: Warm, elegant festive atmosphere with restrained gold light against a dark, professional interface.

style.visualDirection: Premium dark UI, golden highlights, subtle warm illumination.
style.shadows: Soft amber glow used sparingly around selected accents and primary actions.
style.borders: Fine warm-gray borders with occasional muted gold highlights.

decorations.placement: A few small diyas near lower page corners or outer edges.
decorations.animation: Gentle flame flicker and low-intensity glow.

decorations.placement: Along selected top edges or hero-section boundaries.
decorations.animation: Subtle staggered twinkle; avoid rapid flashing.

decorations.placement: Two or three lanterns in open background space, mainly around the hero.
decorations.animation: Slow vertical drift with a tiny horizontal sway.

decorations.placement: Behind hero artwork and selected section edges.
decorations.animation: Static or very slow opacity shift.

art.assetStyle: Minimal SVG silhouettes with warm gold and amber light; realistic detail should remain subtle.
avoid: Large decorations behind headings or buttons
Excessive sparkles, fireworks, or saturated orange backgrounds
Placing diyas near text or interactive controls

motion.reducedMotion: Disable movement and use a still glow or static SVG.
